name: Kumo Tsukai
source:
Main character gets a spider bite in an expedition. That infuses him with great lust and desire to abduct women. He has had his fun with expedition women and now comes back to Japan in search for more victims.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在一次探險中被蜘蛛咬傷。被咬之後，他不但性慾大增，還起了綁架女性的念頭。他已經玩弄過探險隊的女性，如今回到日本尋找更多受害者。

[來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
